claim: The author presents the minimal MAINTAINERS proposal as descriptive documentation of existing practice.

span.quote: purely descriptive of the current role of maintainership

limits_and_alternatives: The assertion of descriptiveness is an object of analysis, not proof every proposed sentence is true.

claim: Focus areas are debated as mutable descriptions; the author explicitly denies that they are enforced rules.

span.quote: The focus area is something that is entrusted to the maintainer to decide for themselves.
these are not enforced rules, just documentation.

limits_and_alternatives: The local exchange weighs against reading listed areas as binding and exclusive jurisdiction.

claim: The author closes the unmerged proposal and leaves it available for others.

span.quote: doesn't seem like there is desire to improve documentation here, closing / up for grabs.
Please mark up for grabs, thanks

limits_and_alternatives: Author withdrawal is not a project-wide constitutional vote.

claim: The unmerged proposal establishes a newly adopted constitution allocating exclusive subsystem authority.

span.quote: these are not enforced rules, just documentation.

limits_and_alternatives: Discussion can concern recurring arrangements without establishing adoption, exclusivity or constitutional-level change.
